PrivacyPage.intro: This notice explains what personal data the {brand} website keeps about you, why, who helps us handle it, how long we keep it, and what you can ask us to do. {brand} is one garage, at {address}.

data.title: What we keep, and why
data.lead: The website keeps personal data when you ask for a login code, when you log in, when you give your name or add a vehicle to your account, when you book, when you ask for a free estimate, and when you review a job. Here is each thing it keeps.

number.title: Your mobile number
number.what: Your 10-digit mobile number, with India's +91. It is also your login.
number.why: To log you in with a code we send by SMS, and to contact you about your bookings by SMS, WhatsApp or phone.
number.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the website and its database.
number.howLong: As long as you have a login with us. You can ask us to delete it.

name.title: Your name
name.what: The name you give us after your first login.
name.why: So the garage knows who you are, and to greet you on the website.
name.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database. If you write a review, your first name is shown publicly with it (see "Your reviews").
name.howLong: As long as you have a login with us. You can ask us to correct or delete it. A review keeps its own copy of your first name: changing or deleting your name doesn't change a review you've already sent.

vehicles.title: Your vehicles
vehicles.what: Each vehicle you add to your account: its type, brand, model and fuel, its registration number, and its PUC and insurance expiry dates if you add them.
vehicles.why: So the garage knows which vehicle is yours when you book or visit.
vehicles.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
vehicles.howLong: As long as you have a login with us. You can ask us to delete one vehicle; its details stay in any booking made with it (see "Your bookings").

bookings.title: Your bookings
bookings.what: Each booking you make: a copy of the vehicle's details (its type, model, fuel and registration number), the time slot, the services you chose and their prices, and the booking's history: when it was made and by whom, and each change the garage's staff make to it (confirming it, cancelling it with a short reason, marking that the vehicle didn't come, and which mechanic it's given to), with who made the change and when. If you ask for pickup and drop, also the address and PIN code you give and the fee. Once your vehicle reaches the garage, also the progress of the work (each step), the notes the garage writes for you, the photos it takes of your vehicle, and which of the garage's mechanics is doing the job. If the work needs more than you booked, also the estimates the garage writes for it: each line (a part or labour, what it is, its amount, and whether it's needed or optional), each version, and who wrote and sent it and when.
bookings.why: To run your booking, to collect your vehicle and bring it back when you ask for pickup and drop, to keep the garage's records of the work it was booked for, and to show you the work an estimate covers and its price before the garage does it.
bookings.who: The garage's owner and managers, and the company that hosts the database. A cancel reason is a note for the garage's own records: the website doesn't show it to you. The mechanic doing your job sees its booking, progress and photos until the job is completed or the booking is cancelled or marked as a no-show (the vehicle didn't come), but never your mobile number. Estimates are written and sent only by the garage's owner and managers; the website will show you the version they send you, and doesn't show you estimates yet.
bookings.howLong: For now we keep every booking, with its progress, notes, estimates and history, even after you remove the vehicle it was for. Nothing deletes bookings yet; we'll say here how long we keep them. The garage's photos of your vehicle are kept as "Photos of your vehicle" says.

estimates.title: Your estimate requests
estimates.what: Each request for a free estimate: a copy of the vehicle's details (its type, model and fuel, and its registration number when you pick a saved vehicle), what you wrote about the problem, and when you sent it. Photos you add are described under "Photos of your vehicle".
estimates.why: So the garage can look at the problem and tell you what the work will involve and cost.
estimates.who: The garage's owner and managers, and the company that hosts the database.
estimates.howLong: For now we keep every request, even after you remove the vehicle it was for. Nothing deletes requests yet; we'll say here how long we keep them. Photos you add to a request are deleted {photoDays} days after the first one was sent, even if the garage hasn't answered yet; the request itself stays.

reviews.title: Your reviews
reviews.what: Each review you write of a completed job: the stars you give, your comment if you write one, the first word of your name as it was when you sent it, and when you sent it. It's shown with your vehicle's brand and type from that booking, and with the garage's reply if there is one.
reviews.why: So other customers can read what customers think of the garage's work.
reviews.who: Everyone: a review is public on this website as soon as you send it, with your first name and your vehicle's brand and type. The garage's owner and managers can hide it or reply, and the company that hosts the database stores it.
reviews.howLong: For now we keep every review, also one the garage has hidden: hiding takes it off the website but keeps it stored. Nothing deletes reviews yet; we'll say here how long we keep them. Deleting a booking deletes its review. You can't edit or delete a review on the website: call the garage and they will hide it.

photos.title: Photos of your vehicle
photos.what: Photos of your vehicle that you add on the website, up to {max} at a time, and photos the garage takes of it while working on it. Before a photo is sent, the website makes it smaller (at most {longSide} pixels on its long side) and saves a new copy, which leaves out the location, time and camera details a phone keeps inside a photo.
photos.why: So the garage can see the problem and tell you what the work will involve.
photos.who: You, the garage's owner and managers, the mechanic doing your job (for that job's photos, until it is completed), and the company that stores the photos and hosts the database.
photos.howLong: Photos the garage adds to an update on your job are deleted {closedDays} days after that update. Photos that belong to an estimate are deleted {closedDays} days after it is closed. Other photos are deleted {openDays} days after the first photo of that group was sent, and a photo whose upload didn't finish after {pendingHours} hours. These deletions happen the next time anyone sends a photo, not on a timer. Deleting your login deletes your photos too.

consent.title: Your agreement
consent.what: That you said you're 18 or older and agreed to how we use your number, with the time, the language of the page and the version of this notice you were shown.
consent.why: So we can show what you agreed to, as the law asks.
consent.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
consent.howLong: As long as you have a login with us.

attempts.title: Each request for a login code
attempts.what: Your mobile number, your device's network address (IP address) when the website can see it, the time, and the agreement you gave on the form.
attempts.why: To limit how many codes go to one number or one network, so nobody can flood a phone with texts, and to record your agreement until you log in.
attempts.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
attempts.howLong: We delete these records once they're more than {hours} hours old, the next time anyone asks for a code. They aren't yet deleted on a timer.

codes.title: Login codes
codes.what: The {digits}-digit code we text you, and how many wrong tries were made.
codes.why: To check the code you type.
codes.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
codes.howLong: A code works for {minutes} minutes. We delete it once it's used, or after too many wrong tries. A code that has stopped working is deleted the next time anyone types a code on the website; until then it stays in our records, even after a new code is sent.

session.title: Your login on this device
session.what: A random token that keeps you logged in (in a cookie on your device, and in our records), your device's network address (IP address), your browser's description (its user agent), and when the login ends.
session.why: The token keeps you logged in for up to {days} days. The network address and browser description are recorded by the login software with every login; we don't use them for anything yet.
session.who: The garage, and the company that hosts the database.
session.howLong: Until you log out, or until another login on the same device replaces it. A login that simply runs out stays in our records for now; deleting these automatically is planned.

sms.title: The text message with your code
sms.what: Your mobile number and the message, which includes the code.
sms.who: The company that delivers SMS for us. We'll name it here before the website opens to customers.
sms.howLong: As long as that company keeps its delivery records. We'll say how long here when we name it.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: When you log in, the website sets one cookie, which keeps you logged in. If your browser doesn't tell websites which language you prefer (most browsers do), the website also sets a language cookie, which remembers that you read it in English. It sets no advertising or tracking cookies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask us to show you a summary of the personal data we keep about you and who we've shared it with, to correct it or bring it up to date, to delete it, or to let someone you name act for you if you can't. To ask, call or message us from the mobile number you log in with: that's how we check the request is yours.

withdraw.title: Taking back your agreement
withdraw.body: You can take back your agreement at any time: call or message us. We'll stop using your number and delete the data above, except anything a law requires us to keep. If you have booked with us, we keep your bookings for the garage's records, as "Your bookings" says, and with them your login: your number and your name. We'll say here when we can delete those too. You can't log in again unless you agree again.

contact.title: Questions and complaints
contact.body: Contact the garage: call <call>{phone}</call> or message us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp>. If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

children.title: If you're under 18
children.body: Only people aged 18 or older can log in. If you're younger, please ask a parent or guardian to contact the garage for you.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: If we change what we keep or why, we'll update this notice and its date, and ask for your agreement again the next time you log in.
